transcript.text: Alright everyone, we need to get the production API policy finalized before Monday's launch. I've reviewed the current draft and I see a few gaps we need to address. The draft has rate limiting at 300 requests per minute with a 30-request burst, query depth at 12, and schema introspection is permitted. But the readiness review checklist requires tenant rate tiers and customer-specific limits, and the draft currently has no tenant-specific rate tier. Can someone walk me through where we stand on the checklist items that aren't yet covered in the draft?

I haven't updated the policy draft yet, but this directly addresses the tenant rate tier gap on the checklist.

The production policy must fail closed and trigger rollback when denied requests exceed exactly 2 percent for exactly 10 consecutive minutes. I haven't filed the rehearsal result yet.

The API must disable introspection, set maximum query depth to exactly 8, and add a WAF query-depth rule. I have not opened a security finding yet.
